research.title: Contradiction-Aware Evidence Selection for Question Answering
bullets: Investigated whether conflicting retrieved passages undermine answer reliability, developing an evidence selector that combines relevance scores with pairwise textual entailment predictions.
Designed controlled passage perturbations and ablation experiments to assess evidence selection, answer consistency, and abstention behavior under contradictory retrieval contexts.

research.title: Ambiguity-Sensitive Query Rewriting for Conversational Retrieval
bullets: Formulated a study of unresolved references in conversational search and developed a query rewriting objective balancing contextual specificity against unsupported expansion.
Compared rewritten queries with concatenated conversation histories, analyzing retrieval errors by reference ambiguity, topic transitions, and dependence on earlier turns.

research.title: Selective Intent Classification Under Domain Shift
bullets: Investigated when intent classifiers should abstain under domain shift, leading development of confidence scoring that combines predictive uncertainty with representation distance.
Designed domain-held-out evaluations and calibration ablations, examining how paraphrase variation and unfamiliar intents affect rejection decisions and retained prediction accuracy.

work.title: Text Search and Document Ingestion Services
bullets: Implemented document ingestion handlers, text normalization routines, and search request validation within an existing service architecture for internal document discovery.
Maintained regression tests for indexing updates and malformed inputs, investigated failed ingestion jobs, and documented recovery procedures for routine service operations.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sentiment Classification Models
bullets: Implemented linear classifiers with term frequency features and a pretrained text encoder baseline for sentiment prediction using consistent training and evaluation splits.
Compared classification errors across negation, mixed sentiment, and infrequent vocabulary, examining how feature representation affected predictions on manually reviewed examples.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling Approaches for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented a conditional random field baseline and fine-tuned a transformer token classifier using shared tokenization alignment checks and entity annotation conventions.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, categorizing boundary errors, unseen entity failures, and inconsistencies introduced by subword labeling choices.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Passage Search
bullets: Implemented lexical ranking and dense embedding retrieval over a shared passage collection, applying identical query preprocessing and relevance evaluation procedures.
Compared ranking behavior for exact terminology, paraphrased queries, and underspecified requests, inspecting retrieved passages to distinguish vocabulary mismatch from semantic confusion.
